text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Carl Bildt, the international community's High Representative to Bosnia and Bosnian Foreign Minister Jadranko Prlic discussed in Sarajevo on Wednesday establishement of newly elected authorities. Bildt says it should happen as soon as possible.
- Aleksa Buha, Bosnian Serb Minister for Foreign Affairs claims that Serb entity is ready to establish special relationship with rump-Yugoslavia in the fields of finances, communications and economy.

- Elisabeth Rehn, U.N special envoy for human rights, who visited Sarajevo on Wednesday, was warned by Bosnian Ombudsman that freedom of movement, non-compliance with the law on amnesty and private proprety are a real problem in Bosnia.
